# `GuidingDithered`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

The guide target was dithered by the given offset.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, Mount::NotifyGuidingDithered @0x4f280 and GuidingLog::NotifyGuidingDithered @0x4a5d0 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit socket_json_guider_server_event::NotifyGuidingDithered counterpart |

Sent when a dither movement is applied; callback-driven, no helper throttle. Sent by the guider process (zwoair_guider) on its TCP 4400 event server to every retained connection (G/all). The main imager process, which is a client of 4400, recognises event lines and forwards them unchanged onto TCP 4700 (I/all), so 4700 clients also receive it; the auxiliary imager process deliberately does not forward 4400 events. The imager's forwarding test is lexical (the exact text "Event":" in the line). Custom guider producer: no state, code or error member. The Android app defines this name as an event constant, but no consumer of its members is established. Typically between SettleBegin and the following settle events (INFERRED). Ordering against RPC replies and other guider events is not guaranteed; no sequence number, replay or fixed cadence exists. Runtime reachability of the retained guiding functionality on every model is unresolved.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"GuidingDithered"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `dx` | number | yes | - | Horizontal dither offset; pixels INFERRED. [READ (type); unit INFERRED] |
| `dy` | number | yes | - | Vertical dither offset; pixels INFERRED. [READ (type); unit INFERRED] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.
